title: Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft: a recipe library for agent-made product videos
friendlyTitle: Video Shotcraft gives coding agents ready-made video patterns
summary: Video Shotcraft packages 152 shot recipes, 209 motion previews and a production-ready Remotion template as a skill for Claude Code and Codex. The Apache-2.0 project has about 10,900 stars and includes smoke tests for runnable demos.
friendlySummary: This project contains many shot ideas, motion previews and a Remotion template for making product videos with Claude Code or Codex.
whyItMatters: Developers and marketers can give coding agents concrete motion-design patterns instead of asking them to invent every product-video sequence from scratch. The templates are most useful as editable production scaffolding; teams should still review branding, claims, accessibility and final renders.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can speed up the first version of a product video. People should still edit the design, check the message and review the final render.
